label: SIMULATION (models + datasheet limits), not a hardware test

checks.description: Q1 |VDS| peak when the brick is plugged in reversed (cable ringing into Coss)
Steady reverse leakage through Q1 (model at 40 C) vs IDSS max at 150 C
checks.limit_source: Infineon IRF4905PbF IDSS -250 uA max at 150 C [datasheet]

checks.description: Q1 stays off during a reversed plug-in (peak reverse current through the FET)
checks.limit_source: functional requirement: reverse FET must block (project limit 1 A)
checks.detail: Cgd couples the -24 V drain step onto the gate (VGS down to 0.2 V): the FET conducts for 0 us; the P6KE30A then conducts forward (0 A pk)

checks.description: Most negative board rail (+24V, VMOT, 12 V, 5 V, 3V3) during reversed plug-in
checks.limit_source: aluminium electrolytic: treat reverse bias beyond -1 V as overstress (general manufacturer guidance) [project]

checks.description: Most negative StepStick VMOT during reversed plug-in vs TMC2209 VS abs min -0.5 V
checks.limit_source: ADI TMC2209 abs max VS -0.5 V (lower limit)

checks.description: Most negative 12 V / 5 V regulator input (after the PTC) during reversed plug-in
checks.limit_source: TRACO TSR: no reverse rating published; project -0.5 V (one diode drop)
checks.detail: duration below -0.5 V not computed; +24V minimum -0.76 V

checks.description: WHAT-IF (what-if: same snubber moved onto J1 (VIN_RAW to GND)): Q1 |VDS| peak on a reversed plug-in

notes: Q1 gate-source capacitor fitted in the design: ['C9'] (100n); no what-if needed.
Off-board inlet snubber (sim/externals.json) is included in every run at the brick end of the inlet pigtail.
Brick 25.2 V (+5 %) reversed at the Mini-Fit; the board side is otherwise unpowered (no USB on the DevKit).
Not modelled: a USB cable to an earthed PC while an earthed-negative brick is reversed (outside the D34 netlist).
